final: WITH staff_totals AS (SELECT r.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY r.staff_id), overall AS (SELECT SUM(payment_total) AS overall_total FROM staff_totals) SELECT s.staff_id, s.payment_total, s.payment_total / o.overall_total FROM staff_totals AS s JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_total IS NOT NULL
